|lore=Captured by Jabba. Princess Leia provided a distraction for his henchbeings. Waiting for the first chance to escape. Really made Jabba’s tail wiggle.
|game_text=✶ Deploys free only as an escorted captive of Jabba or a bounty hunter. Your Strangle destiny draws are +1. “Escort alone” on Strangle is treated as “escort.” When released, escort is lost and you may retrieve any three cards (except Strangle).
|errata_history=Versions of [[Princess Leia Organa (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Princess Leia Organa (V) (Virtual Set 8)]]): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 1, slip 15 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “*Deploys free only as an escorted captive of Jabba or a bounty hunter. Strangle can target an escort (even if not alone) and your destiny draw with it is * +1. If released, escort is lost and you may retrieve any 3 cards (except Strangle).” Stats line: “POWER 3 ABILITY 4 FORCE-SENSITIVE”. Deploy *, forfeit 7. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•15” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 15), in the Committee's Remaster template: “✶ Deploys free only as an escorted captive of Jabba or a bounty hunter. Your Strangle destiny draws are +1. “Escort alone” on Strangle is treated as “escort.” When released, escort is lost and you may retrieve any three cards (except Strangle).” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
